messages:
eli: Quick heads-up — int8 bringup caused dedupe to miss many long code/cli snippets. tokenizer boundary drift around backticks and inline JSON.

nina: do you have an example?

eli: short sample pasted: `curl -X POST "/api/v1/run" -d '{"job": {"id":42}}'` vs variants with extra spaces and different quoting. fuzzyhash didn't catch them.

vishal: likely token packing changed. short fix: run a pre-normalize step (normalize quotes, collapse repeated whitespace, escape sequences) before hashing. also rescore with fp32 baseline to avoid qint hash mismatch.

labelops: for labeling, suggest a "cli-code-normalize" queue. batches of 30, senior-only for edge cases. ETA 3h.

eli: config I propose: `--prenormalize quotes,ws,nfkc --rescore q6b-fp32 --fuzzy-ngram 5 --label-batch 30 --gold-delta 0.16`

deduce-bot: queued job dedupe-normalize-1766667000 by eli. status: queued.

nina: I'll add a short doc snippet for labelers showing collapse rules and examples.

vishal: after label sweep let's run a small canary validating hallucination and exact-match on structured outputs. tag canary with dedupe id.

labelops: batches created: 10 (300 samples). assigning now.

eli: thanks all — will follow up with results and RFC for permanent pre-normalize step.
